newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Four die in hailstorms in Romania - agency.
newsitem.headline: Four die in hailstorms in Romania - agency.

text.p: Hailstorms in southwest Romania killed four people and damaged thousands of hectares (acres) of crops, with some of the hailstones hurtling to the ground as big as tennis balls, the state news agency Rompres said on Saturday.
The agency said four farmers were killed by hailstones of up to seven cm (3 inches) in diameter during the storms which hit several villages in the western Oltenia region late on Friday.

Another 60 people were taken to nearby hospitals with various injuries suffered during the storms, when the storms tore the roofs of houses, uprooted trees and formed a thick layer of hailstones on the fields.
Preliminary official data gave no breakdown by crops, but said up to 8,000 hectares (20,000 acres) of various grain crops had been damaged during the storms.

The worst-hit areas were around the region's main city of Craiova, where rescue services worked to clear local roads blocked by trees felled during the storms. Electricity and telephone lines were also cut.
